scope: Standard short-context baseline with 30-minute cache writes. Optional automatic Standard/Fast updates are implemented in AutoPricing.gs. Known Fast/Ultrafast settings produce estimated surcharges; historical unknown tiers retain a disclosed Standard estimate. Luna and auto-review remain excluded. Image output estimates remain separate. Long context, regional processing and 12-hour caches are not modeled. Tier tracking starts on each device first upgraded scan; historical Fast is not backfilled. Fast requires independent FastPrices rates with no fixed-multiplier fallback.
implemented_in: Runtime: Google Sheets Prices!A:G. Formula-based deployments may use J2:P7 with B2:G2 lookup arrays. Image output is estimated by the receiver; this JSON is reference data, not automatic configuration.

image_output_estimate.dimensions: PNG dimensions, rounded up to multiples of 16; invalid/missing dimensions stay unpriced
image_output_estimate.scope: Output only. Excludes text/image input and streaming partial images. Estimated image tokens are separate from measured token totals.

auto_update.manual_prices: preserve edits since last managed price
